purpose: Map how situated human and model observations change across pairs, turns, branches, cultures, perspectives, regions, rubrics, and time without collapsing them into one vibe or quality score.

definition.flow: The ordered or branching transformation from an artifact and context to one or more observations.
definition.vibe: A situated observation pattern tied to an observer, context, moment, instrument, and provenance; never an essence, identity, universal preference, or measure of worth.

license.expression: Human text CC-BY-4.0; model responses CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus provider terms
license.scope: The generic Hub license:cc tag is not an actionable blanket licence, and the human and model components have different terms.

evidence.observation_unit: one participant, one conversation branch, one turn or end-of-conversation reflection, and its collection context

stages: opening prompt and four independently rated model responses
participant chooses a response and continues for two to twenty-two turns
later A/B choices alter the branch
end feedback records attributes and open reflection
loses: counterfactual conversation after each rejected branch
full meaning of a participant's evolving intent

viewer.note: The main configs are available, but the PII/safety metadata config fails because pii_manual_flag changes type from numeric to boolean. It is not an operational safety filter.

route.next_artifact: A sealed turn/branch transition census with k-anonymity-style suppression and no text, user identifiers, free-form identity fields, or narrow demographic slices.

nuances: Stated preferences, turn choices, and end feedback can disagree; that disagreement is signal rather than an error to erase.
Joinable free text, timestamps, location, religion, ethnicity, and participant identifiers create a meaningful reidentification surface.
The terms explicitly prohibit deanonymisation or triangulation; census-matched US/UK subsets do not make the whole sample representative.

license.expression: Annotations and profiles CC-BY-4.0; audio uses per-track CC BY, CC BY-SA, or CC BY-NC terms
license.scope: The repository-level CC-BY-4.0 tag does not replace each audio track's licence.

evidence.observation_unit: one listener's valence and arousal trace for one song, nominally labelled 10 Hz in the card but with the filtered sampling grid unresolved, linked to a pseudonymous profile

stages: listener hears a full-length track
listener moves valence and arousal controls in a raw capture the card labels as 0.1-second sampling
anchor-track and response-range checks filter raters
per-rater rescaling and smoothing create the published filtered trace

viewer.reported_rows: 54 audio rows in Viewer; 3,482 filtered annotations, 6,176 raw annotations, and 196 profiles in repository Parquet files
viewer.note: The Viewer exposes the audiofolder only and omits the time-series annotation and profile tables that make the research artifact useful.

route.next_artifact: A licence-aware, profile-suppressed trace-shape study that compares raw versus transformed dynamics without retaining audio or individual profiles.

nuances: Filtering, rescaling, and smoothing change the emotional trajectory rather than merely cleaning it.
The card reports 452 participants in one summary and 447 raw raters in its corpus table; the paper's raw stage reports 358 participants and 4,441 trials, so raw names different pipeline stages.
Filtered arrays are consistent with a 0.5-second downsampled stage even though the card labels both tables 10 Hz; exact transform order and response lag remain unresolved.
Only 191 of 196 profile IDs occur in filtered annotations, while many filtered raters have no profile; profile joins must preserve missingness.

license.expression: Hub YAML/API Apache-2.0; README body ODC-By-1.0 with additional research/education language
license.scope: No content route should assume one of the contradictory declarations wins.

evidence.observation_unit: one English or Chinese writing prompt, two model responses, and an expert-validated pairwise preference

stages: instructors design and validate a genre-specific prompt
multiple models generate candidates
expert annotators score candidates on a four-point rubric
only agreed, score-separated pairs become chosen/rejected examples

viewer.note: The current Dataset Server reports a complete 25,126,178-byte table.

route.next_artifact: A language/category and length-bias audit that requires licence clarification before any response text is collected.

nuances: The public files contradict the card's length-matched framing: chosen responses are materially longer on average, especially in English.
Agreement filtering hides the shape of disagreement and can make subjective judgments appear more objective than the raw annotation process.

license.scope: The terms attach conditions to access and copyrighted WikiArt works; license:other is not a general open-data grant.

evidence.observation_unit: one artwork, one native-language annotator response, one emotion label, and one affective caption

stages: a WikiArt work is selected through the inherited ArtEmis collection
native English, Arabic, or Chinese speakers choose an emotion and write a caption
multiple annotations remain attached to the same artwork
cross-language analyses compare distributions without declaring one culture canonical

viewer.reported_rows: Card claims ArtEmis plus roughly 790,000 Arabic/Chinese and 4,800 Spanish annotations
viewer.note: The live Dataset Server cannot process the arbitrary Python loader, whose current S3 split URLs return 403 and carry no source hashes.

route.next_artifact: A cultural-coverage and terms review; any future analysis must keep artwork rights and annotation language attached.

nuances: Difference between language groups is not proof of an intrinsic cultural trait.
The card itself notes that assuming WikiArt represents the cultures of interest is a limitation.
The card says three languages while the paper also reports a small Spanish cohort; split totals and paper totals differ materially.
The loader re-enumerates ids within each split, so a future cross-language join needs a stable artwork/content identity rather than uid alone.

license.expression: Generated layer CC-BY-4.0; upstream creative, technical, and SVG sources carry separate terms
license.scope: The generated dataset licence does not clear Reddit-derived, Media Cloud, or mixed-licence upstream artifacts.

evidence.observation_unit: one simulated collaborative turn, its artifact, criteria-history snapshot, completion, and model-derived score

stages: an initial artifact and latent criteria seed the exchange
simulated interaction reveals or revises criteria
criteria_history records the evolving control tree
a reward model scores each completion
loses: upstream context not carried into the generated row

viewer.note: The Dataset Server exposes all three declared configs.

route.next_artifact: Reuse the criteria-history topology with invented local fixtures; do not import simulated scores as human preference labels.

nuances: Its hidden gem is the evolving criteria tree, not the scalar score.
A simulator can test whether a protocol tracks changing intent, but cannot establish what people actually prefer.

license.scope: The repository declares CC-BY-4.0, but that does not remove privacy duties or validate the card's broad copyright claims about generated images.

evidence.observation_unit: one participant's repeated aesthetic rating of one generated image, linked to image metadata and a pseudonymous profile

stages: a prompt and style configuration generate an image
a participant rates the image on a one-to-five aesthetic instrument
repeated ratings reveal within-person and between-person variation
seen-user and unseen-user splits test personalization transfer
loses: why a participant chose a rating
distinction between beautiful, liked, preferred, and attention-grabbing

viewer.reported_rows: 5,083 image rows in Viewer versus 69,904 ratings described in the card
viewer.note: Ratings and profiles are nested in a ZIP, the Viewer only sees images, and a macOS resource-fork image causes row post-processing errors.

route.next_artifact: A privacy and packaging repair proposal centered on per-person trajectories and ties, never demographic taste prediction.

nuances: The card warns that 199 participants across 23 nationalities are not globally representative.
Card field counts disagree for visual groups and style categories; the archive also contains a parallel __MACOSX tree.

license.scope: The repository declares Apache-2.0; model/image provenance is still too incomplete to infer upstream rights from the wrapper.

evidence.observation_unit: one generated image and prompt with aggregated alignment, coherence, and style feedback plus localized low-score evidence

stages: a text prompt and an undisclosed generator produce an image
human responses separately assess alignment, coherence, and style
missing prompt words and low-scoring image regions localize negative evidence
release rows expose averages and heatmaps rather than rater distributions

viewer.note: The Viewer is complete, but it exposes only aggregates, not the claimed 1.5 million underlying responses.

route.next_artifact: Prototype a local negative-evidence sidecar with invented images and region masks; keep each dimension separate.

nuances: Localized failure evidence is more actionable than the overall style average.
The attached arXiv identifier describes a predecessor method, not this release, so it cannot substitute for release-specific provenance.

license.scope: The checked-in generated dataset is declared Apache-2.0.

evidence.observation_unit: one prompt, one explicit creative rubric, one low/moderate/high control qualifier, and one model response

stages: a writing prompt receives one explicit style rubric
a low, moderate, or high qualifier sets the requested degree
a teacher model generates a controlled response
a separate model-derived preference set ranks rubric compliance
loses: open-ended qualities outside the selected rubric

viewer.reported_rows: 1,328 control rows; companion preference repository has 900 rows
viewer.note: The companion vicgalle/creative-rubrics-preferences is pinned separately in the sources, not silently merged.

route.next_artifact: A local rubric-control fixture showing that requested shape and observer preference are different layers.

nuances: The reversible low/moderate/high control is the useful mechanism; the model judge is not evidence of human taste.
Explicit controls make it possible to ask for a shape without claiming the shape is better.

license.expression: README applies CC-BY-4.0 to original text annotations and says painting images are not included; live repository conversion includes an image column and about 25.4 GB
license.scope: The current bytes contradict the card's component boundary, so neither the global tag nor the prose is sufficient for an image-content route.

evidence.observation_unit: one WikiArt painting, four model-generated interpretive perspectives, inherited human emotion grounding, and one model-synthesized caption

stages: image and metadata condition narrative, formal, emotional, and historical model prompts
the emotional lane also consumes ARTEMIS-v2 crowd grounding
four generated perspectives remain as separate fields
a text model harmonizes them into one unified caption
loses: conflicts softened by the unified synthesis

viewer.note: The live schema and byte size include image data despite the README saying images are not redistributed.

route.next_artifact: A packaging and rights audit; reuse the four-perspective topology only with local or clearly licensed fixtures.

nuances: Multiple fluent perspectives are still model outputs, not independent human interpretations.
The unified caption can erase productive contradiction between perspectives.

license.scope: The repository declares Apache-2.0; public user text and pseudonymous IDs still require privacy and content review.

evidence.observation_unit: one message in a multilingual conversation tree with parent, rank, review, emoji, label, and synthetic/model context

stages: a message enters a multilingual tree
human or synthetic replies create branches
reviews, labels, emojis, and sibling rank annotate branches
ready, all, spam, prompt, train, and validation exports apply different inclusion views

viewer.reported_rows: 128,575 train and 6,599 validation messages; card also exposes tree-oriented exports
viewer.note: The tabular Viewer is a flat message view; the repository's tree exports retain a different conversation shape.

route.next_artifact: A text-free branch-shape calibration census that suppresses user identifiers and rare-language slices.

nuances: A flat Viewer row is not a conversation; branch structure must be reconstructed from parent and tree ids.
Deleted or negative-review exports can reveal why a clean training view looks smoother than the underlying process.
